get.description: Begins the PKCE sign-in flow for a command-line client. Supply the loopback redirect_uri your CLI is listening on, an opaque state value, and the S256 code_challenge whose verifier you keep locally; the response returns the hosted authorization URL to open in a browser, echoing back the redirect_uri and state to compare on the callback. Only loopback redirect URIs are accepted, so an authorization code can never be delivered off the machine that asked for it.

post.description: Trades a refresh token for a new access token and refresh token without another browser round trip, returning the same session payload as the initial exchange. Pass organization_id to move the refreshed session to another organization the signed-in user belongs to. Store the returned refresh token: the presented one is consumed.

Completes the PKCE flow: send the authorization code your loopback callback received together with the code_verifier matching the challenge you started with, and receive an access token, a refresh token, and the identity, organization, role, and entitlements the session carries. The code is single-use, and an exchange without the matching verifier is rejected.
post.summary: Exchange a CLI authorization code for an access token.

get.description: Returns immutable significance calibrations matching both caller-supplied scope identities. Discovery never selects a calibration for search.

get.description: Returns one significance calibration: the target space, release, semantic profile, and search policy it is scoped to, the score field it calibrates, the protocol and null-construction identities behind it, the eligible support it was estimated over, and its manifest digest and size. A score outside that support is reported as a null measurement with a typed support status rather than extrapolated.
get.summary: Retrieve one immutable homology calibration

get.description: Returns authenticated-principal transport, paging, batch, retention, and request ceilings. Release-dependent scientific semantics remain on immutable release resources.
get.summary: Retrieve effective homology transport and request capabilities

get.description: Returns one cursor page of the homology databases available to search, each with its molecule type, the query kinds it accepts, the evidence it can return, and the immutable release its default alias resolves to when one is published. A search always executes against a release id, never against a mutable alias.
get.summary: List searchable homology databases

get.description: Returns one cursor page of a database's immutable releases, ordered by release id, each with its record and residue counts, its aliases, and the release-owned capability contract naming the search policies and evidence it can serve. A release id always identifies the same searched content. A release whose capability cannot currently be resolved is reported as unavailable with a warning rather than dropped from the page.
get.summary: List the immutable releases of a homology database

get.description: Returns one cursor page of the search policy ids releases advertise. Each entry names the releases that execute the policy, the semantic profiles and policy contracts it binds to, the benchmark evaluations that describe it, and the releases that select it by default. Pass database_release_id to see only the policies one release accepts.

get.summary: List release-advertised homology search policy ids

get.description: Returns the immutable compatibility contract of one search policy id: its digest, the releases that execute it, the semantic profiles and policy contracts it binds to, the benchmark evidence published for it, and the releases it is the default for. A policy states which searches may run against which releases; the ranked meaning of a result is fixed by the semantic profile instead.
get.summary: Retrieve release compatibility for a homology search policy id

get.description: Returns the metadata fields a target-space filter may reference on one immutable release, with each field's type and permitted operators, the search policies the schema applies to, and the size limits a filter expression must stay within. A record missing a referenced field evaluates as unknown under strong-Kleene semantics rather than silently as false.
get.summary: Retrieve the metadata filter schema of a homology release

get.description: Returns one cursor page of frozen benchmark evidence, filterable by release, semantic profile, search policy, or target space. Each entry states the benchmark and baseline it measured, how many queries and independent homology groups it covers, and its promotion decision. Evaluation evidence is scoped to a benchmark, never to an individual query or an individual returned hit.

get.description: Returns one cursor page of the searches retained for the authenticated principal, most recently created first, each with its current status, its immutable release and policy receipts, and its result-set summary. Searches past their retention window are not listed; retrieving one by id still reports its expiry explicitly.

post.description: Creates one durable search from scientific intent. Without Prefer, the server waits up to 2 seconds. Prefer: respond-async returns after durable acceptance; Prefer: wait=N waits up to N seconds. Returns 201 when terminal within that window and 202 otherwise. Transport preference never changes scientific execution.

get.description: Returns one cursor page of the semantic profiles releases can select. A profile fixes the scientific meaning of a search — the embedding contract results are comparable within, the ranked unit, the ordered comparators, and the tie-breaker — and deliberately exposes no retrieval or execution settings.
get.summary: List immutable homology semantic and ranking contracts

get.description: Returns one immutable semantic profile: its alias and digest, the encoder compatibility class and embedding dimension results are comparable within, the ordered comparators that define the ranking, the tie-breaker applied to equal scores, and whether the resulting order is deterministic. Scores and ranks are comparable only across searches that share a semantic profile id.
get.summary: Retrieve one immutable homology semantic and ranking contract

get.description: Returns the status of one compilation and, once it is complete, the id of the immutable target space it produced. Poll this resource after an accepted compilation request. The canonical filter digest it echoes lets a caller confirm the compilation belongs to the filter they submitted.
get.summary: Retrieve a homology target-space compilation

get.description: Returns the exact searched universe a target space defines: the release, corpus snapshot, and semantic profile it is bound to, the canonical filter it was compiled from, and the eligible record and residue counts that database-aware significance is computed against. The same canonical filter on the same release always resolves to the same target space id, so a target space can be reused across searches and cited in results.
get.summary: Retrieve an immutable reusable homology target space

get.description: Returns one cursor page of the calibrations scoped to one immutable target space, optionally narrowed to a single search policy. Discovery reports which calibrations exist; choosing one for a search stays an explicit caller decision.
